Top 5 in MBBS test get full scholarships

neg_marking_math.math_sci_reasoning: No penalty → ALWAYS fill every answer

type1_memory.fix: Flashcards, 50-fact card daily, write from memory 5x

type2_analysis.example: Vectors cannot be added by simple arithmetic because ___
type2_analysis.fix: For every fact ask WHY. Generate analysis-only MCQs.

type3_application.example: Parachute moves east at 20m/s. Ball thrown out. Speed of ball?
type3_application.fix: Scenario drills. Predict answer BEFORE reading options.

_2020_P1.q: Which characteristic is NOT shared by mammals and birds?
The proof that birds have reptilian ancestors is evident by...
Plants are killed in winter by frost ___
_2020_P1.ans: (A) Desiccation and mechanical damage to the tissue
_2020_P1.trap: No photosynthesis, respiration ceases, no transpiration - ALL WRONG

_2020_P1.q: Events during action potential at the axon
_2020_P1.ans: (C) More potassium inside than outside - resting state

_2020_P1.trap: Calcareous bones(wrong - sharks cartilaginous), air in bones

_2020_P1.q: Lymph vessels do NOT contain one of the following:
Which characteristic makes bacteria survive intense heat environments?
_2020_P1.ans: Their enzymes work at high temperatures (thermostable)

_2020_P1.q: Cochlea diagram - A=Perilymph, B=Tectorial membrane, C=Endolymph, D=Sensory hair cells
_2020_P1.ans: A:Perilymph B:Tectorial C:Endolymph D:Sensory hair cells

_2020_P1.q: Guard cells from monocot/dicot - label A,B,C
_2020_P1.ans: A=Epidermal cells, B=Guard cells, C=Subsidiary cells

_2020_P1.q: Which reacts with AgNO3 giving white precipitate AND is acidic?
_2020_P1.ans: (B) Propyne - terminal H makes acidic + silver acetylide

_2020_P1.q: Which element burns with white flame and gives cloudy smoke?
_2020_P1.trap: Sulfur burns BLUE, silicon doesn't burn white

_2020_P1.q: Compound reacts with ozone → ozonide → Zn/water → aldehyde. What is it?
_2020_P1.trap: Benzene(ring-opened product), methane(no double bond), propene

_2020_P1.q: In pi bond formation in sp2 hybridization, which orbitals overlap?
_2020_P1.ans: (A) p-p - lateral overlap of unhybridised p orbitals
_2020_P1.trap: (C) sp2-sp2 is SIGMA not pi - most common wrong answer

_2020_P1.ans: Pyramidal shape - N with 2 H and 1 lone pair
_2020_P1.trap: Linear or trigonal planar - wrong geometry

_2020_P1.q: S has maximum oxidation state in which compound?
Parachute east at 20m/s. Ball thrown at 4m/s. Speed of ball?
Conductor L=3m, B=0.1T, v=0.2m/s. Induced EMF?
_2020_P1.trap: (A) 0.6V decimal error - appeared directly in options

_2020_P1.q: To increase fringe distance in YDSE: (i)shorter wavelength (ii)increase screen (iii)decrease slit
_2020_P1.ans: (A) ii and iii - fringe width y=λD/d
_2020_P1.trap: Shorter wavelength DECREASES fringe width - option i is wrong trap

_2020_P2.q: If DNA of unborn baby matched with mother: X chromosome present means...
_2020_P2.ans: (B) If Y chromosome present its a boy

_2020_P2.q: What is importance of first step of Glycolysis?
_2020_P2.trap: Does not directly produce ATP or NADP at first step

_2020_P2.q: What reacts with AgNO3, KMnO4, decolorizes bromine AND is acidic?
_2020_P2.trap: Propene(no AgNO3 white ppt), ethylene(not acidic)

_2020_P2.q: Which EM radiation absorbed by coloured compounds?
_2020_P2.trap: IR is heat, UV bleaches, microwaves too low energy for electronic transitions

_2020_P2.q: Wheatstone bridge - if no current through galvanometer, value of P?
_2020_P2.trap: Not just reading the diagram values directly

_2020_P2.q: Doubling of mass when net force constant → acceleration?
_2020_P2.trap: (A) Doubles acceleration is WRONG (F=ma, double m → half a)

_2020_P2.q: Red light through green filter on blue object - what colour seen?
_2020_P2.ans: (B) Black - red filtered by green, blue absorbed by object, nothing reflected
_2020_P2.trap: Green(filtered out), red(filtered out), blue(absorbed by object)

_2020_P2.q: Fungi used as insecticides argument - what supports limited potential?
_2020_P2.ans: (C) Some fungi may be host-specific parasites (limited to certain insects)
_2020_P2.trap: (A)reproduces inside insect, (B)controls behavior - support the use not limit it

_2021.q: Correct table for organelles (option C: Ribosome=non-membrane, Lysosome=single, Chloroplast=double)
_2021.ans: (C) Correct - Ribosome non-membrane, Lysosome single-membrane, Chloroplast double
_2021.trap: Mitochondria is double NOT single membrane

_2021.q: Correct blood pathway from heart to lungs?
_2021.trap: Starting from left side - pulmonary circuit goes RIGHT side first

_2021.q: Glucose in blood but NOT in urine - why?
_2021.ans: (D) Actively transported from proximal convoluted tubules (reabsorbed back)
_2021.trap: 'Too big to filter' - WRONG, glucose IS filtered at glomerulus

_2021.q: Mother AB, father O. Possible blood groups of children?
_2021.ans: (A) A and B only - AB gives I^A or I^B; O gives only i allele
_2021.trap: Cannot get O blood type from AB parent - no i allele in AB

_2021.q: Why are oomycetes NOT part of kingdom fungi?
_2021.ans: (B) Presence of centrioles AND cellulose in cell wall
_2021.trap: Fungi have CHITIN (not cellulose) and NO centrioles

_2021.q: Why C4 plants more efficient than C3 in hot climate?
_2021.ans: (B) They reduce the oxygenase function of rubisco (prevents photorespiration)
_2021.trap: 'Have bundle sheath' is structural only, not the efficiency mechanism

_2021.q: N2 bonds: how many sigma and pi?
_2021.trap: 3 sigma bonds is most common wrong answer

_2021.q: Which amine does NOT form carbylamine? Biphenyl amine vs R-NH2 vs aniline
_2021.trap: Aniline IS primary aromatic amine - it DOES give carbylamine

_2021.q: Molecules that rotate around single bond are called?
_2021.trap: Geometrical isomers require restricted rotation (double bond)

_2021.ans: (D) P- and Cl+ both have 16 electrons (isoelectronic)
(D) Photoelectric effect - NOT E=mc² or Relativity
_2021.trap: Relativity is what everyone thinks - WRONG

_2021.q: Angle of acceleration vs velocity in circular motion?
_2021.ans: (D) 90° - centripetal acceleration always perpendicular to velocity

_2021.q: Mass 100kg at 180km/h. Velocity halved - centripetal force becomes?
_2021.trap: 1/2 times - using F∝v instead of F∝v²

_2021.q: YDSE: λ=484nm, D=275cm, d=0.1mm. Find fringe width y?
Two bodies toward each other at v - relative velocity?
Th232 undergoes alpha, then beta, then beta decay. Final?
_2021.ans: 2 beta after 1 alpha: Z-2+2=same Z, A-4. Final element same Z as Th, A=228
_2021.trap: Not tracking each decay step carefully

_2022.q: Respiration in plants occurs in: all cells/green cells/stomata/guard cells?
_2022.ans: (D) Guard cells - have many mitochondria for ATP to open/close stomata
_2022.trap: Stomata are openings not cells; ALL cells respire but guard cells specifically asked

_2022.q: Body temperature at Gilgit where temperature is 0°C?
How many phloem components are LIVING? A)2 B)3 C)4
_2022.ans: (B) 3 - sieve tube cells + companion cells + phloem parenchyma. Phloem fibres=DEAD

_2022.q: Selective reabsorption of amino acids and glucose in nephron?
Polypeptide of 250 amino acids - mRNA nucleotides needed?
Water transport from soil to phloem - which pathway?
_2022.trap: Symplastic goes through cytoplasm - not the soil→phloem pathway

_2022.q: DNA amount Y after division. In prophase of meiosis, DNA = ?
_2022.ans: (B) 2Y - S phase (replication) occurs BEFORE meiosis begins
_2022.trap: Y (forgetting S phase), Y/2 (only at end of meiosis I)

_2022.q: Main difference between prophase meiosis and mitosis?
_2022.ans: (B) In meiosis centromere does NOT separate; homologs separate. In mitosis centromeres divide.
_2022.trap: Thinking crossing over is the main structural difference

_2022.q: Which gas shows highest deviation from ideal behaviour? H2/CO2/NH3/N2
_2022.ans: (C) NH3 - strong H-bonding causes greatest deviation
_2022.trap: H2 shows LEAST deviation (smallest, weakest IMF)

_2022.q: Rate law from initial rates table (NO+O→NO2+CO2)
_2022.ans: Rate=k[NO][O] - first order each from doubling experiment
_2022.trap: Reading the table wrong or assuming overall order

_2022.q: Half-life=3min. Initial count 567. Final count 69. Half-lives passed?
Correct order highest→lowest wavelengths in spectra?
_2022.trap: Reversing to energy order (Lyman=highest energy=SHORTEST wavelength)

_2022.q: Blue light through double slit - what spectrum?
_2022.ans: (C) Bands of black and blue - interference pattern
_2022.trap: Continuous spectrum(wrong) or line spectrum(wrong - that's emission)

_2022.q: Ball A(mass m, vel V) strikes stationary B(mass m). What happens?
_2022.ans: (C) Ball A stops, Ball B moves right at V - elastic collision equal masses
_2022.trap: Both move or A continues - momentum must be conserved

_2022.q: Photoelectric effect cannot be explained by which theory?
_2022.trap: Corpuscular/particle theory - it actually helps explain it

_2023.q: Fission of euglena differs from paramecium in direction:
_2023.ans: (D) Vertical (longitudinal) - Euglena divides longitudinally, paramecium transversely

_2023.q: Haemodialysis - concentration of which substance kept SAME as blood?
_2023.ans: (D) Glucose - dialysate matches blood glucose so glucose not lost

_2023.q: Which blood group does NOT exhibit co-dominance?
_2023.ans: (D) O blood group - ii genotype, no allele expressed preferentially
_2023.trap: A,B,AB all exhibit co-dominance or dominance

_2023.q: Closing of Venus flytrap on touch - which movement?
_2023.ans: (A) Haptonastic - plant response to touch stimulus

_2023.q: Role of fruit specific to reproduction?
_2023.ans: (D) Seed dispersal - attracts animals → seeds spread to new locations
_2023.trap: Nourishment, protection also roles but not SPECIFIC to reproduction

_2023.q: Phases of menstrual cycle in correct order?
_2023.trap: Luteal first or any reverse order

_2023.q: Oxidation number of Cl in ClO4-?
Which is an alkane among C2H6, C3H6, C3H8, C4H10?
_2023.ans: C3H8 (propane) and C4H10 are alkanes (CnH2n+2). C3H6=propene(alkene)
_2023.trap: Mixing propane/propene - students say C3H6 is propane

_2023.ans: (B) Ge (Germanium) - poor conductor normally, conducts when temp raised
_2023.trap: Na is always good conductor. Si also semiconductor but Ge more classic answer

_2023.q: Principal quantum number=3, how many values of m possible?
_2023.trap: Counting for all l values instead of maximum ml values

_2023.q: 51cm3 NH3 reacted with 100cm3 O2 (4NH3+3O2→...). O2 remaining?
Coffin box clicks 12.3/sec, fresh wood 24.6/sec, half-life 5600yr. Age?
Work: F=10N, angle=60°, distance=8m. Work done?
Weight in coal mine, sea level, mountain - correct order?
_2023.ans: (C) WC<WS>WM - sea level=max, mine and mountain both less than sea level
_2023.trap: Mine=greatest (closer to center actually reduces slightly due to mass distribution)

_2023.q: Entropy order: ice, liquid, vapour, mixture
_2023.ans: (A) Ice - lowest entropy (most ordered solid state)
_2023.trap: Mixture or gas has HIGHEST entropy, ice has LOWEST

_2023.q: Drop of water under mercury in manometer - what happens?
_2023.ans: Water rises (less dense than mercury: ρwater=1, ρHg=13.6)
_2023.trap: Sinks (denser - wrong, water is less dense)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Which one of these is NOT a result of the release of catecholamines?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) Production of glycogen - catecholamines cause GLYCOGENOLYSIS (breakdown) not synthesis
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Piloerection(A), Dilated pupils(B), Increased heart rate(D) ARE all catecholamine effects

Heuser_Mock3.q: Which part of nephron helps in CONDITIONAL reabsorption of sodium ions?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (A) DCT - aldosterone triggers conditional Na+ reabsorption
Heuser_Mock3.trap: PCT(obligatory-no hormone), Henle's loop(NaCl), Renal corpuscle(filtration)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Sensory neuron enters spinal cord through:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (A) The dorsal root of the spinal nerve - Bell-Magendie Law

Heuser_Mock3.q: Metabolism of which gives greatest net usable energy PER GRAM?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (A) A triglyceride - 9 kcal/g vs 4 kcal/g for protein/carb
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Tripeptide or disaccharide - less energy per gram than lipid

Heuser_Mock3.q: Salivary gland cells would contain relatively large amount of:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (B) Rough endoplasmic reticulum - for secretory protein production
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Smooth ER(lipid synthesis), genetic material, lipids

Heuser_Mock3.q: Which organism has both blood vessels AND digestive tract food flows ONE direction?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) Annelids - closed circulation + complete gut (mouth to anus)
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Flatworms(ONE opening only), Sponges(no true gut)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Which ion significantly involved in opening/closing of stomata?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) Potassium - K+ enters → water follows → turgid → OPEN

Heuser_Mock3.q: Electronic config 1s22s22p63s23p63d9 represents:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) Metallic cation - this is Cu2+=[Ar]3d9

Heuser_Mock3.q: Energy difference between reactants and transition state is:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) The activation energy

Heuser_Mock3.q: Thermos flask is example of:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (B) Isolated system - no energy OR matter exchange
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Closed(energy can exchange), Open(both can exchange)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Which spontaneous at any temperature? ΔG/ΔS/ΔH all?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) ΔG and ΔH are negative, and ΔS is positive - ΔH<0+ΔS>0=ALWAYS spontaneous
Heuser_Mock3.trap: All negative(ΔH<0+ΔS<0 is temp-dependent, not always)

Heuser_Mock3.q: HClO Ka=3×10-8. H+ concentration in 0.12M HClO?
Heuser_Mock3.trap: 3.6×10-9(wrong formula, not square root), 3.6×10-8(Ka value directly)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Wire stretched to increase length 10%. Percentage increase in resistance?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) 21% - R∝L2 when volume constant. (1.1)2=1.21 → +21%

Heuser_Mock3.q: KE of gas double that at 27°C. Temperature = ?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) 327°C - KE∝T(Kelvin). 27°C=300K. Double=600K=327°C

Heuser_Mock3.q: Two coils: one boils water in 6min, other in 3min. SERIES - time?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) 9 minutes - Series: t=t1+t2=6+3=9 min
Heuser_Mock3.trap: 3 or 6 minutes (using parallel formula for series)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Angle between two EQUAL vectors whose resultant = magnitude of either?
Lady 60kg in elevator moving UP at a=2m/s2. Scale reading? (g=10)
Rain falling vertically. Man running east - rain appears from?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (A) East - relative velocity concept. Rain has eastward component relative to runner.

Heuser_Mock3.q: Body moves only when:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (B) Force of friction < applied force (strictly GREATER, not equal)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Fog - why difficult to see through?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (A) Light is scattered by the droplets (Mie scattering)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Soap helps in cleaning because:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) It lowers the surface tension of the solution

Heuser_Mock3.q: Milk spoils sour with curds because:
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (C) Bacteria produce lactic acid → lower pH → denatures milk proteins
Heuser_Mock3.trap: Fermentation produces ethanol(wrong), yeasts form citric acid(wrong)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Equilibrium: Ge + 2Cl2 ⇄ GeCl4, K=1×10^10. Then 2GeCl4 ⇄ 2Ge + 4Cl2?
Cork weight=mg, density=25% water. Totally immersed on string. Tension?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: (D) 3mg - Buoyancy=4mg (water density 4× cork). Tension=4mg-mg=3mg

Heuser_Mock3.q: P=4/9 probability - which total is impossible?
Heuser_Mock3.ans: 64 - 64÷9=7.1 (not whole number). Total MUST be divisible by denominator(9)

Heuser_Mock3.q: Marble P(4/9): NOT green both drawn? Box 30: 8 black, 10 green, 12 yellow

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: In YDSE, slit separation halved, screen distance doubled - fringe width?
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (D) Becomes 4 times - y=λD/d, d halved→2×, D doubled→2×, total 4×

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: Buoyant force as rock sinks deeper in water of constant density?
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (B) Remains constant - buoyant force=ρgV, only depends on volume and fluid density

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: Transition n=4 to n=3 gives UV. Infrared from which transition?
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (D) 5→4 - longer wavelength = lower energy transition (larger n values)
(B) x=0 - at equilibrium position all energy is kinetic

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: Anti-bonding molecular orbital has greater energy than bonding MO?
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (D) Anti-bonding MO - higher energy, less stable
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.trap: Same energy or bonding MO higher

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: Kp and Kc NOT equal in which equilibrium? (PCl5 ⇄ PCl3+Cl2)
Spontaneous at all temperatures: exothermic+increasing disorder?
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (A) Exothermic AND increasing disorder - ΔH<0 + ΔS>0 = ALWAYS spontaneous
(D) I2 and NaOH (iodoform test) - acetophenone has CH3CO- group, benzophenone doesn't

Heuser_Mock4_SAT.q: Transition metals - catalytic activity associated with:
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.ans: (D) Variable oxidation states - can accept/donate electrons
(B) Copper liberated at cathode, oxygen at anode
Heuser_Mock4_SAT.trap: Copper at anode(wrong), sulfur anywhere(wrong - stays as SO4)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Blood group antigens are:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (D) Proteins present on the surface of RBCs (glycoproteins)
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Carbohydrates in plasma(wrong location), plasma proteins(wrong)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Common in both arteries and veins:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (A) Endothelium - inner lining of ALL blood vessels
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Tissue fluid(not inside vessels), low blood pressure(wrong for arteries)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Which enzyme has pH 1.4?
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (A) Pepsin - gastric enzyme works in highly acidic stomach
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Amylase(pH7), lipase(pH7-8), enterokinase(slightly alkaline)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Resting axonal membrane:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (C) More permeable to potassium than to sodium ions
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Not polarized(wrong-it IS polarized), more Na inside(wrong)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Tricuspid and bicuspid valves CLOSED because of:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (B) Attempted backflow of blood into the atria - pressure closes them
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Atrial systole(opens not closes), ventricular relaxation(opens them)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Oxyntic cells secrete:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (A) HCl - parietal/oxyntic cells in stomach wall secrete HCl
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Pepsinogen(chief cells), mucus(goblet cells)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Erythroblastosis foetalis condition arises when:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (B) Rh- female carries Rh+ fetus - mother makes anti-Rh antibodies
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Rh+ female with Rh- fetus(reversed - wrong)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Oxytocin helps in:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (D) Lactation AND childbirth both
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Only lactation or only childbirth - it does BOTH

Heuser_Mock5.q: K equilibrium: 1/2N2+1/2H2⇄NH3, K=8. K for N2+H2⇄2NH3?
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (B) 64 - doubling reaction squares K: 82=64
Heuser_Mock5.trap: 16(squaring 4), 2√2(wrong manipulation)

Heuser_Mock5.q: pOH of solution with 1×10-10 M hydronium ions at 25°C?
Heuser_Mock5.trap: 7.00(neutral), 9.00(using pH directly as pOH)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Why F- smaller than O2- ion?
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (C) F- has greater nuclear charge than O2- (9 vs 8 protons pulling same e- count)
Heuser_Mock5.trap: More electrons(wrong - both have 10e-), higher electronegativity(consequence not cause)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Rate constant has dimension of frequency - order of reaction?
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (B) First order - k units = s-1 = frequency
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Zero order(k=mol/L/s), second order(k=L/mol/s)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Radioactivity drops to 1/64 in 30 seconds. Half-life?
Heuser_Mock5.trap: 2s(wrong power calculation), 6s(getting half-lives and time confused)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Which cannot be emitted in radioactive decay?
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (D) Protons (protons alone are NOT emitted - alpha particle includes protons)
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Helium nucleus=alpha(CAN be emitted), electrons=beta(CAN be emitted)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Fats separated from milk in cream separator because of:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (C) Centrifugal force - cream separator spins to separate by density
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Gravitational force(too slow), cohesive force(wrong principle)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Piano at constant speed when pushed horizontally:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (C) Dynamic equilibrium - moving at constant velocity = net force = 0
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Static equilibrium(at rest), no friction(friction exists)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Boiling point of water lower at high elevations because:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (D) Atmospheric pressure is lower at high elevations
Heuser_Mock5.trap: H-bonds weaker(wrong), vapor pressure higher(consequence not cause)

Heuser_Mock5.q: In UCM - velocity changes and acceleration changes:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (D) Both velocity and acceleration change (both are vectors with changing direction)
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Speed changes(scalar speed is CONSTANT in UCM)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Colour of shirt: black absorbs all, white shirt cooler because:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (C) White shirt reflects more sun's energy
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Black shirt cooler(opposite)

Heuser_Mock5.q: Blue light vs red light:
Heuser_Mock5.ans: (A) Higher frequency, shorter wavelength, carries more energy
Heuser_Mock5.trap: Lower frequency for blue(wrong - blue has HIGHER frequency than red)

distractor_trap_types.chemistry: Enzymes LOWER vs PROVIDE activation energy

distractor_trap_types.chemistry: 36 ATP as distractor in photosynthesis Q

distractor_trap_types.desc: Too broad or too narrow answer

Water droplets SCATTER (not absorb) light - Mie scattering
Hydrophobic tails disrupt H-bonds at surface
aa=2 alleles, Aa=1 allele of each type
Bacteria consume O2 faster than algae produce

Choose: MORE SPECIFIC detail (collecting duct > kidney, p-p > orbital overlap)
